label: החזר על מבצע
reason: Numbers align with verified ground truth (65% uplift, 34% no-lift). SQL logic correct: baseline filtering (hp=0, bm≥2), ratio calc, tier classification. Minor: assistant rounds incremental_units differently (232,613 vs 232.6K stated verbally); disclosed May-2026 anchor. Seasonality caveat missing.
answerSql:
WITH raw_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    l.PrtC AS prt,
    h.DateDoc AS d,
    (year(h.DateDoc) * 100 + month(h.DateDoc)) AS ym,
    l.Cmt AS qty,
    (l.Scm - l.VatAmount) AS net,
    CASE WHEN l.MivzaNo > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_promo
  FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
  WHERE h.DateDoc >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND l.Cmt > 0
),
im AS (
  SELECT 
    prt, 
    ym, 
    SUM(qty) AS qty, 
    SUM(net) AS net, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS nd, 
    MAX(is_promo) AS hp
  FROM raw_sales 
  GROUP BY prt, ym
),
pm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prt FROM im WHERE ym = 202605 AND hp = 1
),
b AS (
  SELECT 
    im.prt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.qty ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.nd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS may_qpd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.net ELSE 0 END) AS may_net,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.hp = 0 THEN im.qty ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN im.hp = 0 THEN im.nd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS base_qpd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.nd ELSE 0 END) AS may_nd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.hp = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bm
  FROM im 
  JOIN pm ON im.prt = pm.prt 
  GROUP BY im.prt
),
c AS (
  SELECT 
    *, 
    may_qpd / NULLIF(base_qpd, 0) AS ratio, 
    (may_qpd - base_qpd) * may_nd AS incremental_units
  FROM b 
  WHERE bm >= 2 AND base_qpd > 0
)
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN ratio >= 2.0 THEN '1. גידול חזק (פי 2 ומעלה)' 
    WHEN ratio >= 1.2 THEN '2. גידול מתון (1.2 עד 2)'
    WHEN ratio >= 0.9 THEN '3. ללא שינוי (0.9 עד 1.2)' 
    ELSE '4. ירידה בכמות (מתחת ל-0.9)' 
  END AS tier,
  COUNT(*) AS items, 
  ROUND(SUM(may_net), 0) AS may_net,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(may_net) / SUM(SUM(may_net)) OVER(), 1) AS net_share_pct,
  ROUND(MEDIAN(ratio), 2) AS median_ratio, 
  ROUND(SUM(incremental_units), 0) AS incr_units
FROM c 
GROUP BY tier 
ORDER BY tier

answerSql:
WITH pcost AS (
  SELECT 
    ItemID AS prt, 
    SUM(FinalRegularCostPrice) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS unit_cost
  FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/DailyPriceCost.parquet')
  WHERE FinalRegularCostPrice > 0
  GROUP BY 1
),
fp_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    l.PrtC AS prt,
    SUM(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) AS fp_net
  FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
  WHERE h.DateDoc >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND (l.MivzaNo IS NULL OR l.MivzaNo = 0) AND (l.AczDisLine IS NULL OR l.AczDisLine = 0)
  GROUP BY 1
),
mp AS (
  SELECT 
    l.MivzaNo AS mz, 
    l.PrtC AS prt, 
    SUM(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) AS pnet, 
    SUM(l.Cmt) AS pqty,
    SUM((l.Scm - l.VatAmount) * l.AczDisLine) FILTER (WHERE l.AczDisLine BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AS dnum,
    SUM(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) FILTER (WHERE l.AczDisLine BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AS dden
  FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l 
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
  WHERE l.MivzaNo > 0 AND h.DateDoc >= DATE '2024-01-01' 
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
mz AS (
  SELECT 
    mp.mz, 
    SUM(mp.pnet) AS promo_net,
    SUM(mp.pnet - COALESCE(pc.unit_cost, 0) * mp.pqty) FILTER (WHERE pc.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) AS promo_gp,
    SUM(mp.pnet) FILTER (WHERE pc.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) AS promo_net_costed,
    SUM(mp.dnum) / NULLIF(SUM(mp.dden), 0) AS depth,
    SUM(fp.fp_net) AS fp_net,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.prt) AS nprt
  FROM mp 
  LEFT JOIN pcost pc ON mp.prt = pc.prt 
  LEFT JOIN fp_sales fp ON mp.prt = fp.prt
  GROUP BY mp.mz
)
SELECT 
  'מבצע ' || CAST(mz AS VARCHAR) AS name,
  ROUND(promo_net, 0) AS promo_net_val,
  nprt, 
  ROUND(depth, 1) AS depth_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * promo_gp / NULLIF(promo_net_costed, 0), 1) AS promo_margin_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * (promo_gp / NULLIF(promo_net_costed, 0)), 1) AS value
FROM mz 
WHERE promo_net > 100000 AND fp_net > 0 AND promo_net_costed > 0
ORDER BY promo_margin_pct ASC
LIMIT 15

WITH raw_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    l.PrtC AS prt,
    date_trunc('month', h.DateDoc)::DATE AS ym,
    h.DateDoc AS d,
    l.Cmt AS qty,
    l.MivzaNo > 0 AS is_promo,
    l.AczDisLine BETWEEN 0.01 AND 100 AS is_discounted
  FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/Prt.parquet') p ON l.PrtC = p.C
  WHERE h.DateDoc >= DATE '2025-01-01' 
    AND p.GroupC = 511 
    AND l.Cmt > 0
),
monthly_item_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    prt, 
    ym, 
    SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_promo AND NOT is_discounted THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS fp_qty,
    MAX(CASE WHEN prt = 42327 AND is_promo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_active,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS active_days
  FROM raw_sales
  GROUP BY prt, ym
),
promo_months AS (
  SELECT ym, MAX(promo_active) AS is_promo_month
  FROM monthly_item_stats
  GROUP BY ym
),
monthly_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    mis.ym,
    pm.is_promo_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mis.prt = 42327 THEN mis.total_qty ELSE 0 END) / MAX(mis.active_days) AS target_qpd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mis.prt <> 42327 THEN mis.fp_qty ELSE 0 END) / MAX(mis.active_days) AS mates_fp_qpd,
    SUM(mis.total_qty) / MAX(mis.active_days) AS total_group_qpd
  FROM monthly_item_stats mis
  JOIN promo_months pm ON mis.ym = pm.ym
  GROUP BY mis.ym, pm.is_promo_month
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN is_promo_month = 1 THEN 'תקופת מבצע (תבנית L במבצע)' ELSE 'תקופת מחיר מלא (תבנית L במחיר מלא)' END AS phase,
  COUNT(*) AS nmonths,
  ROUND(AVG(target_qpd), 1) AS target_item_qpd,
  ROUND(AVG(mates_fp_qpd), 1) AS mates_fullprice_qpd,
  ROUND(AVG(total_group_qpd), 1) AS whole_group_qpd
FROM monthly_aggregates
GROUP BY is_promo_month
ORDER BY is_promo_month DESC

          h.StoreC,
          TRIM(s.Nm) AS branch_name,
          SUM(h.Scm - h.ScmMaam) AS net_revenue,
          COUNT(DISTINCT h.C) AS transaction_count,
          SUM(h.Scm - h.ScmMaam) / COUNT(DISTINCT h.C) AS avg_basket
